dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 10, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Thrilling Day in MLB as Tigers Stun Phillies, Yankees Edge Nationals**

The Detroit Tigers dominated the Philadelphia Phillies 10-2 behind a strong team effort, with Derek Hill leading the charge with 3 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs. Kevin McGonigle, Colt Keith, and Spencer Torkelson also contributed with key hits. On the mound, Jack Flaherty earned the win, while Aaron Nola had a solid outing with 5 innings pitched, 8 strikeouts, and 2 earned runs.

In other games, the New York Yankees edged the Washington Nationals 5-3 behind a strong pitching performance from Ryan Weathers, who threw 5.1 innings with 6 strikeouts and 1 earned run. James Wood led the Yankees' offense with 3 hits, including a home run. Austin Wells also homered for the Yankees, while Cody Bellinger and Paul Goldschmidt led the Nationals with 2 hits each.

The Chicago Cubs were shut out by the Cincinnati Reds 4-0, with Hunter Greene pitching a complete game and striking out 12 batters. JJ Bleday homered for the Cubs, while Spencer Steer and Elly De La Cruz contributed with key hits for the Reds.

The Seattle Mariners fell to the Tampa Bay Rays 7-2, with Junior Caminero homering for the Mariners. The Cleveland Guardians edged the Miami Marlins 3-2 behind a strong pitching performance from Sandy Alcantara, who threw 7 innings with 8 strikeouts and 3 earned runs. Chase DeLauter homered for the Guardians, while Leo Jiménez also contributed with a home run.

The Boston Red Sox defeated the New York Mets 6-2 behind a strong pitching performance from Nolan McLean, who threw 6 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. Wilyer Abreu homered for the Red Sox, while Brett Baty homered for the Mets.

The Chicago White Sox crushed the Oakland Athletics 14-1 behind a strong team effort, with Tristan Peters leading the charge with 4 hits, including a home run, and 4 RBIs. Sean Burke earned the win on the mound, pitching 7 innings with 9 strikeouts and 1 earned run.

The Texas Rangers edged the Houston Astros 7-3 behind a strong team effort, with Jake Burger leading the charge with 1 hit, including a home run, and 4 RBIs. Cole Winn earned the win on the mound, while Steven Okert pitched 1 inning with 2 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

The Los Angeles Angels edged the Minnesota Twins 4-3 behind a strong team effort, with Vaughn Grissom leading the charge with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs. Grayson Rodriguez earned the win on the mound, while Kirby Yates earned the save.

The Pittsburgh Pirates and Milwaukee Brewers played to a 0-0 tie, with neither team able to score.
